date_note: Date is the day of the Wall Street Journal report as relayed by Reuters; the pages give no date for the attacks themselves.
title: US reportedly investigates whether Iran was behind dozens of cyberattacks on energy tankers
summary: The Wall Street Journal reported, in a version carried by Reuters, that the US is investigating whether Iran was behind dozens of cyberattacks on energy tankers. As many as 50 ships carrying oil, liquefied petroleum, chemical products and other explosive substances are believed to have been attacked, and some received bomb threats. Russia is also seen as a possible culprit. Reuters could not immediately verify the report.
plain: The Wall Street Journal reports that US officials are investigating whether Iran was behind dozens of cyberattacks on tankers. As many as 50 ships are believed attacked. Reuters could not immediately verify the report.
exec: A WSJ report, relayed by Reuters, says the US is investigating whether Iran was behind attacks on as many as 50 tankers; Reuters could not verify it.

evidence.quote: As many as 50 ships carrying oil, liquefied petroleum, chemical products and other explosive substances

validation.note: Reuters (via WHBL) and Ynetnews both relay one Wall Street Journal report, so it is one underlying source; the WSJ original was not read. Reuters says it could not immediately verify the report; no US government statement was read.

review.note: Compared title, up to 50 ships, Russia, Reuters could not verify with Reuters/WHBL and Ynetnews; developing and single_source correct
